CustomField.description: Emails the respondent a link back to their draft after they save, on non-stages forms only, at most once an hour per submission. The form asks for the email on the first save that has a recipient email (Contact 1, Contact 1 Email or Email), on the first save after the respondent reopens a link, and again only when the last email was more than an hour ago; the Send Save Progress Email flow sends it. The link is the Web Form URL with a single-use pv9 token, so the Web Form URL must be set and pv9 mapped to Unique Token with a prefill flow that resumes by token. Has no effect in stages mode, where the Send Resume Email button sends the link instead. A custom upsert override that does not pass the whole record through drops the request, and no email is sent.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Emails respondents a link back to their draft after they save, at most once an hour. Non-stages forms only; needs a recipient email on the submission and a Web Form URL. Uses Email Template Name (Saved) when the submission has a Contact 1, otherwise a built-in message.
CustomField.label: Send Save Progress Email
